title: Form 1099-DIV box 2a statement items, tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every capital-gain distribution amount reported in box 2a of a Form 1099-DIV furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item as of the keyed horizon. This claim covers Form 1099-DIV box 2a only: it says nothing about boxes 1a or 1b, residual recorded non-composable boxes (3, 5, 7, 12), boxes 2b/2c/2d, dividends not reported on Form 1099-DIV, or Form 1040 line 7a completeness. Closed with members authorizes the multi-payer sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0.
